'''Freight Administrator''' was an [[Administrator/Legends|administration]] role at the [[Estaria Central Starport]]. The Freight Administrator was responsible for overseeing all services and fees for the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport's]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] bays. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Ela Harns]] served as Freight Administrator.<ref name="HS" />
